reviews.text: Samara is a great professional. I have a highly sensitive dog, and I feel very comfortable leaving him in her care. There aren't many dog ​​trainers in my area, so I travel from the west side of São Paulo because I know her service is worthwhile. I recommend her without hesitation.

Samara is wonderful. I spent two months at the school in 2024 to learn more about how the place works and about dog training, and I can say with certainty that well-behaved dogs bring quality of life to both owners and the dogs themselves. Now in 2026, I visited the school again, stayed for 20 days observing the routine closely, and confirmed everything I experienced in 2024, but now multiplied in many other animals. You can call Samara with your eyes closed and see the change happen in your animals!
Their work is incredible and the team is super attentive. The way we interact with our dog has completely changed since we started training with CallMyDog!

I have complete confidence in the Call My Dog team, led by the lovely Samara Arsego. My two dogs have been attending the school for over a year and a half, and have also stayed at their boarding facility several times. Call My Dog is our support network here in São Paulo, and I couldn't be more grateful!

Best dog school in town!
Samara has an admirable love and respect for dogs, and I have complete trust in these professionals to take care of my dog!
Call My Dog is the best! Dedicated, prepared, and above all, loving professionals! My dog ​​loves going there and is improving a lot in terms of behavior! I recommend them without hesitation!!
Extremely grateful for Samara's consulting services! A very competent, empathetic, sensitive, and exceptional professional. Special work and a super complete report! ❤️ Thank you for everything!!!!

I found Call My Dog on Google and contacted them for a consultation about my dachshund's behavior and training. Samara came to my house, analyzed her behavior, and taught us how to train her. I could already see progress in the first few days; she started barking less at the door, and during periods when she was alone, she stopped howling and crying. The entire training is done in stages, and you only move on to the next one once your dog is responding well to the last lesson. I'm continuing the training and I'm excited about her progress. I highly recommend them!

The best dog training school ever!

I have two dogs of primitive breeds, a Siberian Husky and a Yakutian Laika. And anyone who lives with this type of dog knows that they have very specific behavioral characteristics and challenges. The school played a fundamental role in their training and, especially, in our role as owners.

I strongly believe in the method of Samara, the school's owner. The work goes far beyond training: there is a human, respectful, and individualized approach to each animal, something I consider super important.

Another point that has always given me peace of mind is the care, responsibility, and safety with the dogs. I've never been afraid to leave them there because I know how attentive, committed, and prepared Samara and her team are. Other issues important to me, such as escape prevention, constant supervision, and animal welfare, have always been treated with extreme seriousness.

Today, it's the only place I trust my dogs completely. And this trust comes from having closely observed how the work is done. This is a team that truly loves what they do and delivers impeccable work.

A perfect score.
Excellent service! In addition to being super attentive and providing detailed explanations, she gave excellent tips for our daily life with our pet. I recommend her!
Samara was great taking care of my dog ​​Bela! She answered all my questions 🥰 I highly recommend her. …
Samara was a huge help in managing my household routine, especially in implementing effective changes with my dogs. She's also extremely attentive and competent. I highly recommend her!
Samara was very attentive and careful with Mike, she brought a lot of knowledge to us talking about behaviors, answered our questions and gave us a lot of support to start the training.
We had a consultation with Samara for our 7-month-old Husky and it was excellent!! She is super attentive, competent and professional, in addition to being a great person!! We highly recommend her!!

Samara provided consulting services to help resolve some issues with our 5-month-old puppy, Cisco. He's quite energetic, and we weren't sure how to best manage him. The consultation brought relief to our routine, highlighting fundamental issues, simplifying how to handle the puppy, and offering guidance on important topics for first-time pet parents. In just one week, I've already noticed a significant difference in his behavior and obedience.

The initial consultation with Samara was wonderful. She knows a lot about canine behavior and has a lot of patience to explain and correct the mistakes we make unintentionally. The lesson was very enlightening, and at all times it was noticeable how much she cares for pets.

We were very satisfied and highly recommend her to all pet owners who need her services.

I loved the consultation!! Samara is great. Very experienced and friendly. Training is very fun and useful, and Samara knows very well how to do it and teach how to do it. She does it with love. She likes dogs, and my puppy liked her.
